verdict.rationale: Bolna offers AI post-call processing: optional LLM call summaries (call_summary_enabled) and model-backed extraction categories attached to an agent, both configured in the analytics tab. These could be set up to capture outcome-style data, but nothing in the evidence shows dedicated automatic quality scoring, failure flagging, or resolution analysis. Call history provides performance metrics, recordings and transcripts, but for manual review rather than AI evaluation. Missing for 10: built-in AI quality scoring of calls, automatic failure/issue flagging, explicit resolution analysis, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
